title: Folio Administration: Extras Taken during a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
Extras taken during a Hotel Rate Plans stay are posted to the folio as they occur, each against the room and the occupant that took them. One clause of this note has been withdrawn and is marked as such.

**1. When an extra may be posted.** An optional extra taken during the stay is posted only while the reservation record stands at checked in or checked out. The reservation record is the authority for that, not the guest's account of where the stay has reached.

**2. Breakfast.** Breakfast is charged per person per day on a plan that does not include it, and an all-inclusive plan charges nothing for meals, soft drinks or listed activities at all.

**3. Spa.** Spa treatments carry the plan's spa discount, applied before tax, and the discount is never given in money where no treatment is taken.

> **Withdrawn.** *"At departure the folio is closed off: every posted line is settled against the deposit already held and the balance is taken from or returned to the card on file."* — this clause is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded on the question of how the balance settled at departure is struck.

**4. A disputed line.** A line disputed at departure is left on the folio and referred to the property desk rather than removed at the front desk.

## When an optional extra may be posted

| Reservation record stands at | An optional extra may be posted |
| --- | --- |
| reserved | no |
| confirmed | no |
| checked in | yes |
| checked out | yes |
| cancelled | no |
| recorded as a no show | no |

## A point of judgement

*A guest on an all-inclusive plan asks for the value of the meals they did not take.* The plan charges nothing for meals, soft drinks or listed activities; nothing is charged, and nothing is owed back in their place. The same principle governs the spa discount, which is never given in money where no treatment is taken.

superseded_clauses: At departure the folio is closed off: every posted line is settled against the deposit already held and the balance is taken from or returned to the card on file.
